description: Pure enrichment module exposing compute_score(metadata) returning (float, dict). Uses permission_types list, permission_count, has_fs_access, has_env_access, has_network_access, has_process_spawn to compute permission scope score. Current signal has only 3 distinct values (WEAK -- low variety). MUST read at least 6 metadata fields; MUST return evidence dict listing partial scores per permission category; MUST NOT write to DB or call network; MUST complete in under 2 seconds.
